key_facts.reason_jp: 企業価値の向上および株主還元の充実、経営環境変化への対応、機動的資本政策

summary_en: 200,000 shares (5.0% of shares outstanding) to be acquired via ToSTNeT-3 at ¥1,250/share (day's close). Upper limit ¥250M. Single execution window 2026-08-05, 8:45 JST, settlement same day. No partial execution if orders insufficient.
summary_jp: 200,000株（S/O 5.0%）を ToSTNeT-3で ¥1,250/株で買付け。上限 ¥2.5億。2026-08-05午前8時45分に単一執行。売付注文に対当する買付注文。
